title: Anunnaki came to Earth to mine gold

tellings.quote: the story of the Anunnaki. They were coming here to mine gold and precious metals.

plain: Beings called the Anunnaki, known from ancient Middle Eastern stories, came to Earth to mine gold and other precious metals. A guest named Geoffrey Drumm repeats this on Michels's show as the story of the Anunnaki, without citing a source, in a conversation about what he believes the pyramids were really for.
